name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio: Dimitrios' journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, during his time maintaining HVAC systems at a local university. He became fascinated by the principles of aerodynamics and fluid dynamics. This interest led him to volunteer at a small racing team, eventually securing a position assisting with wind tunnel testing. Dimitrios is meticulous and methodical, focusing on precise data collection and analysis. His strength lies in his practical approach to problem-solving, always seeking the most efficient and reliable solutions to optimize aerodynamic performance. While not naturally innovative, Dimitrios' dedication to continuous improvement and his willingness to learn from others make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.description: Dimitrios is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on calibrating the wind tunnel equipment himself before each session.
Has a collection of miniature airplanes on his desk.
